# Scroll Bridge

> Scroll Bridge is a non-custodial interface for bridging ETH, USDC, USDT and other tokens between Ethereum and Scroll, a zkEVM rollup on Ethereum. Users connect their own wallet and sign every transaction. The page explains native versus fast bridges, fees and gas, and withdrawal claiming.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Scroll is a zkEVM rollup that settles on Ethereum.
- The interface bridges ETH, USDC, USDT and other tokens between Ethereum and Scroll.
- Gas on Scroll is paid in ETH, so a small ETH balance is needed on Scroll.
- Native bridge withdrawals become claimable on Ethereum after their batch is proven and finalized, which can take hours; the user then claims on Ethereum.
- The interface is non-custodial: the user signs from their own wallet and it never holds funds or keys.

## Pages

- Scroll Bridge & learn: https://bridge-scroll.github.io/
- Legal: https://bridge-scroll.github.io/legal.html
